_comment: Starter CAPVisualizer assertion pack. Declarative expectations evaluated offline against an export by CapTest.psm1 / Invoke-CapTest.ps1. Independent DSL (not Pester). Assertion types: compliance (a baseline control result), findingThreshold (no findings at/above a severity), whatif (a simulated sign-in outcome). The compliance assertions cover every Conditional-Access-automatable CISA SCuBA MS.AAD control; tune or remove any that do not apply to your tenant.
name: CAPVisualizer starter assertions

assertions.name: Phishing-resistant MFA must be enforced for all users (MS.AAD.3.1)
MFA must be required for all users (MS.AAD.3.2)
Phishing-resistant MFA must be enforced for privileged roles (MS.AAD.3.6)
Managed devices should be required for authentication (MS.AAD.3.7)
Device code authentication should be blocked (MS.AAD.3.9)
Risky AI agents must be blocked (MS.AAD.9.1)
There must be no critical-severity findings
There should be no high-severity findings
